entities.summary: Elizabeth Haydon is an American fantasy author. Her Symphony of Ages series contains two trilogies, a duology, and a final book, and begins with Rhapsody: Child of Blood (1999). Her other series, The Lost Journals of Ven Polypheme, is set in the same universe but serves as a historical prequel. Her most recent publication is The Weaver's Lament (2016).
